types.name: DraftsOptions
types.doc: What a host passes as FormRenderer's `drafts` prop (drafts contract section 3).

members.name: mode
members.doc: "off": store nothing, anywhere, and restore nothing — not even after a refresh. Overrides the schema's mode. For kiosks and shared devices.

members.name: scope
members.doc: Opaque: identifies the user and, when it matters, the subject (patient, visit…). Required for device and server modes; in session mode it keys the tab's copy. Read once, when the form mounts.

members.name: owner
members.doc: Opaque: identifies only the user, so clearDrafts({ owner }) can clear all of their drafts at logout without knowing their subjects.

members.name: label
members.doc: Shown in the restore prompt, e.g. "J. Smith".

members.name: getKey
members.doc: Device mode: the user's AES-GCM 256 key.
